summary: Read one positive integer. It is both the side of a square board and the number of queens to place. Place the queens so that no pair shares a row, a column, or a diagonal, and therefore no pair can capture another. Find every different placement. Mark a queen with the capital letter Q and mark an empty cell with a dot. Write each placement from the top row downward.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
